title: ProgressEvaluationRecordV2

data_class.description: Always synthetic: a progress evaluation runs on public, synthetic, CC0 data only.

run_config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the run's TrainingRunConfig JCS bytes.

generation.description: The generation whose frozen pair was evaluated (0 is the seeded initial pair).

generation_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of generations/g<N>/manifest.json: binds the record to one committed generation.

games.description: One row per game of every match, in match then game order.

description: ADR-017 erratum E2: every validation pair is played from both seats (teams stay on their seats, the policies swap, one battle seed per pair), so a match of n pairs has 2n games. Schema version 2 stands beside version 1 (progress-evaluation-record), which stays readable and is never rewritten.

VersionManifest.description: Replay identity of a battle (ADR-003, ADR-007): the pinned engine commit, the format, and the hashes of the engine ruleset and of Areneon's own format rules.

ruleset_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical engine ruleset.

format_rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of Areneon's format rules record (ADR-007).

Checkpoints.description: A frozen pair, by the ids of its two checkpoints.

preview.description: Checkpoint id (SHA-256 of the file) of the Team Preview network.

battle.description: Checkpoint id of the battle network.

Teams.description: The teams every match was played on.

dataset_hash.description: The team dataset's hash, as the run config names it.

pairs_used.description: Disjoint ordered validation team pairs the record used: the most any match used (half of the largest games_per_match / anchor_games_per_match).

Plan.description: What every match played: derivations, sizes and caps.

games_per_match.description: Games in every baseline and previous match (even): game g is pair g/2 rounded down, played twice (the candidate on p1 for an even g, on p2 for an odd g).

recorded_games_per_match.description: The first this-many games of every match (an anchor match: at most its games) are stored as ProgressGameRecords.

anchor_games_per_match.description: Games in every anchor match (even), laid out as games_per_match. Present exactly when the record has anchor matches.

max_turns.description: The turn cap of the run's TrainingRunConfig.generation: a game still running past it is a tie.

LatencyBudget.description: The per-decision latency budgets of the run's config.

Opponent.description: Who the frozen pair played: a scripted baseline, the previous generation's frozen pair, or a fixed earlier generation's (an anchor).

policy_id.description: The previous generation's pair, in the mode the match played.

AnchorOpponent.description: A fixed earlier generation's frozen pair, the same for every generation evaluated against it.

generation.description: The anchor generation (earlier than the evaluated one).

policy_id.description: The anchor pair, in the mode the match played.

cause.description: Why the policy failed, as the harness classifies a forfeit (crash, out_of_memory, invalid_reply, latency_overrun).

match_id.description: Names the match: <opponent>-<mode>, e.g. random-legal-sample or anchor-g10-sample. Unique in the record; names the stored game files.

policy_id.description: The candidate's policy id in this match's mode: policy: plus SHA-256 of the JCS of {preview, battle, mode, temperature, precision}; for a candidate_preview of kind random the preview is the word random-preview@v1, for kind generation that generation's Preview checkpoint id.

mode.description: The candidate's choice rule: sample at temperature 1, or argmax.

wins.description: Candidate wins, forfeits by the opponent included.

losses.description: Candidate losses, forfeits by the candidate included.

turn_cap_ties.description: Games among the ties that ended because the turn cap was reached.

turns_total.description: Sum of the turns of the match's games.

forfeits.description: Forfeits by side and cause, sorted by side then cause, each pair once.

game_record_hashes.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of each stored ProgressGameRecord of the match, sorted and unique; its length is plan.recorded_games_per_match.

cause.description: Why the policy failed, as the harness classifies a forfeit (crash, out_of_memory, invalid_reply, latency_overrun).

request_seq.description: The failing side's own request number.

Outcome.description: How one game ended, seen from the candidate: played to an end, or forfeited by a policy.

GameRow.description: One game's result: the per-game results table of protocol section 8.1.

game.description: Game index within the match; its pair is game / 2 and the pair's seed is progress-seed/1's for the pair index.

pair.description: The validation team pair the game used: the game index divided by two, rounded down. Both games of a pair share its battle seed; teams stay on their seats.

candidate_seat.description: p1 for an even game, p2 for an odd one: the policies swap seats, the teams do not.

baseline_counts.description: Only a game of a damage-aware match: the baseline seat's integer counts for this game (reader rules: probe_runs and unsupported_queries do not exceed queries; preview_decisions plus scored_decisions do not exceed decisions). The match's baseline.counts are the sums over its rows.

CandidatePreview.description: Which Team Preview the candidate's Battle network played with in an ablation match (ADR-017 erratum E1). Absent: the candidate's own learned Preview, as in every other match.

LearnedPreview.description: The generation's own learned Preview network.

RandomPreview.description: A uniformly random choice among the legal Preview choices the engine's request lists, seeded per seat from the policy stream label.

generation.description: The earlier generation whose Preview network is used (0 is the seeded initial pair).

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint id of that generation's Preview network.

GenerationPreview.description: An earlier generation's learned Preview network.

probe_runs.description: Probe runs actually made (queries not answered from a game's memo).

unsupported_queries.description: Queries the probe answered unsupported: scored 0, never approximated.

reader_fallbacks.description: Requests answered by the actor-rule candidate because the state reader flagged a line.

assumed_set_fallbacks.description: Requests answered by the actor-rule candidate because no legal assumed opponent set could be built.

epsilon_plays.description: Requests where epsilon_ppm made the baseline play a random candidate.

BaselineSummary.description: The damage-aware baseline of a match (ADR-018 sections 4, 5): its identity hash and the per-game counts summed over the match's games (all integers). Present exactly in the matches whose opponent is damage-aware. Added within v1 (ADR-008 section 3): a reader older than the field rejects a record that carries it.

identity_hash.description: The baseline identity hash: SHA-256 of the JCS of {baseline_config_hash, mechanics_config_hash, adapter_format, reader_sha256, version_manifest}. Every game of every damage-aware match of a record carries the same one.
